purpose: Construction roadmap for Stage 4B. This file intentionally plans developed reading, visual cadence, Bank anchors, processing, and summary goals without writing the final notes prose.

framework.conflict_rule: Original Unit Assessment Plan HTML wins on wording/title conflict; current section_index and i_can_index agree with it for Unit 1.

stale_input_check.note: All canonical dependencies and Bank anchors were resolved at the request-pinned commits; no stale upload substituted for repo authority.

build_contract.developed_reading: Required. Use connected prose with accessible grade-10 language; avoid slogan-only, shorthand-only, Q&A-only, or bullet-fragment-only treatment.
build_contract.vocabulary: Define terms in context as concepts are developed, then consolidate vocabulary definition targets immediately before each section Summary.
build_contract.processing: Every non-trivial explanatory passage and every selected visual must route to a canonical Example/Your Turn pair or a Stop & Discuss prompt.
build_contract.bank_pairing: Every canonical Notes Example has exactly one deliberate parallel Your Turn; preserve adjacency and one-time use.
build_contract.visual_cadence: Use image-first or image-adjacent sequencing when a source figure carries the phenomenon/model; do not silently redraw exact source figures.
build_contract.vector_boundary: Magnitude + direction; same/opposite-line forces and familiar/easy geometric cases. Avoid systematic component decomposition.

image_toolkit.selection_rule: Selected assets are exact current toolkit entries with verified rel_path values. The approved course figure unit1-sled-same-direction.png is not selected because no current canonical toolkit asset/path exists for it at the pinned commit.
